question: Does the fixed two-term MLP4 contextual write causally reach the output through the localized last+period+the source terms of L9H1/H4?
population: The same 64 valid A1/A2 discovery rows; no new prompts or selected examples.

operator.writer_hybrid: Run the base sequence after adding the frozen left_change+right_change MLP4 output terms at resid5 on last+period+the.
operator.reader_capture: Capture exact L9 attention patterns, values, and preprojection head outputs in native base and writer-hybrid executions.
operator.mediated_arm: Inside an otherwise native base execution, replace H1/H4 attention source terms at named positions by the corresponding writer-hybrid terms, then run the exact L9 projection and layers10-17 suffix.

predictions.pred_a_exact_path_instrument: An empty writer hook is exactly inert; all writer-hybrid H1/H4 source terms reconstruct the complete writer-hybrid H1/H4 preprojection arm within 0.125 scored logit on every row.
predictions.pred_b_writer_recurrence: The fixed two-term writer recurs within 0.02 of mean recovery 0.33379287409141367, is positive in A1/A2, and has direction fraction at least 0.80 in each.
predictions.pred_c_bank_mediation: The H1/H4 last+period+the mediated arm has positive A1/A2 recovery, direction fraction at least 0.80 in each, and retains at least 40% of the writer arm's mean recovery.
predictions.pred_d_reader_specificity: The bank arm retains at least 80% of the H1/H4 all-source mediated effect, while cue+self retains at most 25% of the absolute all-source effect.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All five arms produce all 64 outcomes with finite scored logits, within 20 model forward calls and 640 example evaluations.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: license the explicit two-term MLP4 -> contextual source bank -> L9H1/H4 causal path on the discovery population.
terminal.null: The experiment is valid but C or D fails: writer and reader remain separately localized without an end-to-end mediation claim.
terminal.invalid: Instrument closure, frozen writer recurrence, native capability, alignment, finiteness, or coverage fails. No arm, head, source, row, or threshold may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First exact end-to-end mediation test connecting a factorized bilin18 MLP response to a localized downstream attention source-bank read.
